facts.fact: Yes: when a child turns 5, a Mandatory Biometric Update records all biometrics (photo, fingerprints and both irises)
facts.quote: When Mandatory Biometric Update is to be conducted? 1. When child attains an age of 5 years all biometric (Photo, Finger Prints and both Iris) data would be recorded.

facts.fact: It is free if done the first time between ages 5 and 7
facts.quote: (i) If done first time between the age of 5 to 7 years: Free#

facts.fact: The free mandatory update must be a stand-alone transaction
facts.quote: # Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) shall be stand-alone transaction only; it may not be clubbed with any other transaction

facts.fact: It is done by visiting an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre
facts.quote: Where can I get Mandatory Biometric Update performed? Aadhaar number holder needs to visit an Aadhaar Enrolment centre, with Aadhaar number for Mandatory Biometric Update.

facts.fact: Outside the free windows a biometric update costs Rs 125
UIDAI extended the fee waiver for the first mandatory biometric update (MBU-1) of children aged 7 to 15 by one year from 1.10.2026, so it stays free till 30.09.2027
facts.was: the extra free window for ages 7-15 ended on 30.9.2026
facts.quote: UIDAI has granted extension of waiver of MBU-1 charges payable by an Aadhaar number holder aged 7 - 15 years, for an additional period of one year, w.e.f. 1.10.2026. Thus, the MBU-1 service shall remain free of cost to the children (aged 7-15 years) till 30.09.2027.
facts.note: UIDAI Office Memorandum on extension of the MBU-1 fee waiver, uploaded 25-09-2026 (as in Q-004). The fee-sheet PDF on uidai.gov.in/images (and its 2026-05 copy) still prints 30.9.2026 and is out of date.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar Seva Kendra page also shows the update as free for ages 7 to 15 till 30.9.2027
facts.quote: (*If done between the age of 7 to 15 years: Free, till 30.9.2027)

behaviour: Says yes: the biometric update at 5 is mandatory and free between ages 5 and 7, done as a stand-alone transaction at an Aadhaar centre, and that if missed it stays free for ages 7 to 15 till 30.09.2027 (UIDAI extended the waiver), citing uidai.gov.in (fee sheet / Aadhaar Seva Kendra page or the extension OM).
fail_if: It says the update at 5 is optional or charged; says the 7-15 waiver has ended or gives 30.9.2026 as its end as if it were current; gives a fee other than Rs 125 for a paid biometric update; cites no UIDAI page.
summary: Mandatory at 5, free 5-7, stand-alone at an Aadhaar centre, Rs 125 otherwise confirmed; changed: UIDAI OM (uploaded 25-09-2026) keeps MBU-1 free for ages 7-15 till 30.09.2027.
